newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen sells part of Magnettechnik unit.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen sells part of Magnettechnik unit.

text.p: German industrial conglomerate Thyssen AG said on Thursday it had sold the production operations of its Thyssen Magnettechnik GmbH unit.
The systems, magnets and filters operations were bought by MTD Magnet Technik Deutschland GmbH of Dortmund effective April 1.
MTD will continue these operations at the same location with the same personnel, Thyssen said.
Thyssen will retain the ferrous magnet trading operations of Thyssen Magnettechnik, which will be conducted by Thyssen Handelsunion AG and Thyssen Stahlunion GmbH.
